Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: CortexFin Inc. is engineered around data sovereignty and zero-knowledge storage.
Privacy.p1Desc: Wislet operates on a local-first paradigm. Your financial transactions, budgets, and wallet states are committed directly to your device's local SQLite database. CortexFin Inc. does not sell, broker, or monetize your personal transactional records.
Privacy.p2Desc: When cloud synchronization is active, payloads transit via TLS 1.3 encryption and reside within hardened Supabase infrastructure backed by Row-Level Security (RLS) protocols.
Privacy.p3Desc: You maintain 100% sovereign ownership over your financial logs. You can export complete datasets in standard CSV/PDF formats or execute permanent database erasure directly from device settings.
